_comment: Copy this file to user_minutes.json (gitignored) to activate a personalized minutes structure. Prefer editing it through the TeamsRecorder app → Settings → 'Personalizar minutas'. The section 'Acciones Pendientes' / 'Pending Actions' is always appended automatically; do NOT include it here or the downstream action parser will break.
source_prompt: Example: I want short minutes focused on decisions and open questions. Skip small talk. Prefer bullet lists over prose.

sections.name: TL;DR
sections.description: Two or three bullets max, capturing the single most important outcome and the next decision to make. No preamble.

sections.name: Decisions
sections.description: Bulleted list of every decision taken. Each bullet: <decision> — <owner> — <rationale in <=15 words>.

sections.name: Open Questions
sections.description: Bulleted list of unresolved questions raised during the meeting, each with who raised it. If none, write 'None'.

template.extra_rules: Prefer bullets over paragraphs. Never include small talk. Keep the whole document under 400 words if possible.
